Boi canh: repo nay (task-manager) tung chay mot phien Council that (session a7d95227, 2026-09-05/06,
4 vong, hoi tu) nghien cuu anh huong cua viec bo AI automation. Ket luan khi do la "mo hinh lai" (giu
code, dong bang phat trien, chuyen task dinh ky rui ro thap sang Claude Desktop/skill thu cong, giu
nguyen co che cu cho phan "Len lich"/announcement rui ro cao) - nhung 2 cau hoi con treo (muc chap
nhan tre, nguyen nhan gay nan chinh) chua bao gio duoc tra loi, va ke hoach ap dung chua he bat dau.

Sau khi can nhac them (6 ngay), nguoi dung QUYET DINH GHI DE ket luan "mo hinh lai" o tren bang mot
huong manh hon: XOA HAN TOAN phan AI automation (khong phai dong bang), roi TAI CAU TRUC lai code con
lai thanh cac module tach bach ro rang de de bao tri ve sau. KHONG bao gom viec go cai CLI Claude/Codex
tren may - chi xoa code/cau hinh trong CHINH REPO NAY dung de goi/dieu khien chung.

Pham vi GIU LAI (khong duoc dung vao, phai con chay dung nhu cu) - doi chieu voi 8 tab chinh that
trong app (tabsChinh trong src/main.tsx):
- Tab "Ca nhan" (task_ca_nhan) - quan ly task ca nhan
- Tab "Du an" (project)
- Tab "Bao cao tuan" (bao_cao_tuan)
- Tab "Len lich" (len_lich) - LUU Y: tab nay duoc render boi server/routes/release.ts + src/screens/release.tsx
  (ham ManHinhLenLich), day chinh la phan "announcement/release" ma phien Council truoc goi la "rui ro
  cao, giu nguyen" - da xac nhan qua doc code rang announcement-activation.ts import truc tiep tu
  automation-config.ts, tuc la CO DUNG CHUNG ha tang voi phan AI automation dinh xoa. Day la diem
  quan trong nhat can Council giai quyet can than.
- Tab "Luyen de" (luyen_de) - lien quan "chung chi"
- Tab "So do" (so_do) - mind map
- Tab "Quan ly PIC" (quan_ly_pic) - gan nguoi phu trach cho task/project, thuan du lieu, KHONG lien
  quan AI/automation - nguoi dung xac nhan GIU LAI du khong nam trong danh sach ban dau ho nhac, vi
  khong lien quan gi toi van de goc.
- Man hinh "Cai dat" (Settings, khong phai mot trong 8 tab chinh, mo rieng - vi du man Cai dat > Phim tat)

Pham vi XOA HET - CA hai nhom:
1. Tab "Skill Forge" (skill_forge) - server/routes/skills.ts, server/lib/skill-forge.ts, src/skill-forge.tsx
   va moi thu lien quan - nguoi dung xac nhan XOA LUON du day la cong cu tao skill Claude (co the lien
   quan huong "mo hinh lai" cu), vi khong con ke hoach dung skill thu cong kieu do.
2. Toan bo ha tang AI automation cho task dinh ky - bao gom nhung KHONG GIOI HAN o cac file da tim
   thay qua grep so bo (CAN Council tu xac minh lai day du, khong dua vao danh sach nay la day du):
   server/lib/automation-config.ts, automation-helpers.ts, automation-prompts.ts, automation-scheduler.ts,
   claude-runner.ts (phan phuc vu automation dinh ky - KIEM TRA rieng phan release co dung chung khong),
   server/routes/automation.ts, server/routes/schedules.ts (kiem tra co dung rieng cho Len lich khong
   hay chi phuc vu automation dinh ky), src/components/automation-*.tsx, src/components/pending-ai-banner.tsx,
   src/components/AiKetQua.tsx, src/lib/automation-*.ts (automation-ask.ts, automation-recovery-deadline.ts,
   automation-results-context.tsx, automation-results-reducer.ts, automation-results-store.ts),
   src/useAutomation.ts, cac bang/schema DB rieng cho automation trong server/db.ts, cac dong config
   trong app_settings lien quan automation, cac muc backlog/docs nhac automation dinh ky.

YEU CAU CU THE cho Council (day la lam viec THAT, khong phai brainstorm):

1. Tu doc code that (khong doan) de lap MOT DANH SACH DAY DU, chinh xac: file nao xoa hoan toan, file
   nao GIU nhung phai TACH rieng phan dung chung voi "Len lich" (vi du automation-config.ts co the can
   tach thanh 2 phan: cai dinh danh Claude/Codex runner dung chung cho release, va cai chi phuc vu
   automation dinh ky), bang DB nao xoa hay giu (du lieu lich su cac lan automation da chay - giu de
   doi chieu hay xoa luon, neu giu thi giu o dau/dinh dang gi).
2. Neu phat hien mot file/module ca hai ben (release va automation dinh ky) cung dung nhung KHONG the
   tach gon (vi du logic dan xen qua sau), phai neu ro day la truong hop kho, de xuat cach xu ly (vi du
   copy rieng mot ban cho Len lich, chap nhan trung lap co kiem soat, thay vi co tach mot cach cuong ep
   gay vo hanh vi).
3. Rui ro cho "Len lich" (dang phuc vu that, rui ro cao) phai duoc danh gia rieng, kem cach kiem chung
   sau khi xoa/tach (vi du chay lai kich ban announcement that/gia lap truoc khi coi la xong).
4. Sau khi xoa xong, de xuat cach TO CHUC LAI module cho phan con lai (8 tinh nang giu lai) thanh cac
   ranh gioi module ro rang, tach bach - de sau nay sua mot tinh nang khong lo anh huong tinh nang khac,
   theo dung tinh than "de bao tri ve sau" nguoi dung yeu cau - KHONG de xuat tach thanh nhieu ung dung/
   exe rieng (da can nhac va nguoi dung tu choi huong nay, vi rui ro tich hop giua cac tool con lai lon
   hon loi ich).
5. Doi chieu voi quy trinh rieng cua chinh du an nay (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md cua task-manager): day la thay
   doi "Duong C" (dung DB, automation, nhieu man) theo phan loai cua chinh du an - phai kem the skill
   `security-gate` (vi dung vao spawn-AI/secret) va co the `docs-sync`. KET QUA cua phien nay la MOT KE
   HOACH/BACKLOG ITEM chi tiet du de mot dev thuc hien theo dung quy trinh do (delivery-flow), KHONG
   phai tu dong xoa code trong chinh phien nay - viec xoa that se lam sau, tren nhanh rieng, co test.
6. Neu phat hien them mau thuan/rui ro nghiem trong voi quyet dinh cua nguoi dung (vi du xoa mot phan
   se lam hong tinh nang dang liet ke "giu lai"), PHAI neu ro nhu mot phan doi chan, khong duoc lang le
   lam theo huong de xoa nhat.
